overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Records Access Officer appointment flowed naturally from the posted PERAC memorandum topic, so it did not need its own notice listing.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board voted on appointing a Records Access Officer at its January 25 meeting, a vote not listed on the notice.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Board had to review the memorandum first in order to learn that the new law required the appointment of a Records Officer, we find that this appointment flowed naturally from its consideration of the memorandum.
